notes.author: Srijan Upadhyay (developer)
notes.subject: Development history: fairness method and data revisions
notes.detail: During development (not registered models): on an earlier synthetic draw the payment-level fairness test flagged Premium 2.96x and age 26-35 at the 2% budget. Repeat payments by one customer counted as independent evidence, so the test now counts customers (clustered), with the payment-level result reported alongside. A remaining Premium signal on that draw did not reproduce across generator seeds 22 and 23. The generator then gained benign recurring payments, households sharing devices and IPs, benign pass-through accounts and new customers; this model is trained on that final data and passes the customer-level test (Private Banking on the watchlist, one window). Re-test on bank data.
